fixture.inventoryScope: Relative file names, sizes and modification times, not content hashes.

measurement.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of all nine samples per configuration; three independent fork blocks, not nine independent forks.
measurement.percentageFormula: (candidate mean / reference mean - 1) * 100; positive is slower.

method.independent_selection: Candidate windows selected solely from resource/process logs, without benchmark-score-based selection, result-based exclusion or causal attribution.
method.background_screen: All top samples and process commands parsed. Candidate windows selected when cf-agent, timestamp, cf-promises, apt-get or python3 CPU was at least 2 percent of one core. This is a resource-screening threshold, not a performance-impact threshold.
method.time_mapping: Candidate CPU windows run from the previous top display UTC to the active sample display UTC; consecutive windows are merged. Snapshot intervals are paired timestamped Starting snapshot / Snapshot all finished records; first interval is warmup, subsequent three are measurements.
method.historical_exclusion: Initial top and vmstat reports excluded from interval CPU/I/O summaries. First diskstats sample retained only as cumulative delta baseline.
limitations: top process COMMAND is not a full command line; process names cannot prove full ownership or activity between samples.
5-second CPU windows and second-resolution top UTC can overlap a snapshot without proving the background CPU work occurred during its timed portion.
Cell markers can lag the actual top display timestamp by approximately 1 second; mapping uses top display timestamps.
No causal attribution, no sample removals, and no claim of a perfectly isolated machine.
Snapshot validation succeeds by returning without an exception; there is no separate success record for each individual validation check.
Overlap mapping uses the logged data-source snapshot interval, not the slightly larger enclosing JMH builder call.

memory.interpretation: No evidence of sustained RAM pressure or swap thrashing; one tiny swap-in interval exists.

java_process_pattern.interpretation: Observed pattern is consistent with one JMH launcher plus one benchmark fork for each of 120 cells; no extra concurrent Java population is visible. Process names alone do not establish command ownership.

disk.interpretation: Large writeback on the benchmark device is expected snapshot/drain work and is not itself evidence of an unrelated user workload. Device aggregate counters do not attribute I/O to a process; diskstats io_ticks occasionally exceed wall-clock delta and are not used as a utilization percentage.

validation_evidence.note: The three index checks validate file length/header and sampled index values, not every serialized byte; store directory and metadata presence are checked.

unflaggedBlockCheck.description: Secondary check only: compare full three-sample block means when neither variant nor its own control has a flagged measured snapshot. Primary means still retain all measurements; an unflagged block is not proof of no interference.
